neighbours.label: The second or later item marker (a number, lowercase letter or roman numeral) in a list or scale whose items are written with a dash, like '1- tea 2- coffee 3- juice' or '(1 - calm; 10 - spirited)'; it peaks on the marker itself, just before its dash, and needs an earlier marker-plus-dash in the same text (glued '2-' strongest). Second triggers: the '-d' of French c'est-à-dire, a site word right after 'http://' (books, maps), the first comma of a French or German sentence. Quiet: a single 'Option 1 -' with no list, one-off ranges, scores and phone numbers (2010-2014, 3-2), the same lists written with '=', 'means' or plain commas, capital-letter markers, English hyphenated words.
neighbours.short: next item marker in a dash-marked list (1- tea 2- coffee)
fire: Pick your drink: 1- tea 2- coffee 3- juice.
Steps: 1- preheat the oven 2- mix the flour 3- bake for twenty minutes.
Choose one: a- red b- blue c- green.
Chapters: i- origins ii- the journey iii- return home.
On a scale from 1 - never to 5 - always, how often do you read?
Shopping list: 1- eggs 2- milk 3- bread 4- butter.
Answer key: a - true, b - false, c - true, d - false.
quiet: The kettle was a well-worn, long-loved heirloom.
Pick your drink: tea, coffee, or juice.
Steps: preheat the oven, mix the flour, and bake for twenty minutes.
Option 1 - take the train into town.
On a scale where 1 means never and 5 means always, how often do you read?
She worked at the library from 2010-2014.

predictions: Blind test written by a label-only author. Expect most fire items to clear 0.20; spaced 'a - true' and lowercase-letter lists are the weakest (letters ~0.13-0.39 in probes).
